Hazte cliente Menú International partners Contáctanos Productos Zona Gaming Top Ventas DMI Pro Blog Productos Zona Gaming Top Ventas DMI Pro Blog International Partners Contacto About us Experience, Quality and Innovation… DMI Computer S.A was founded in 1989, one of the first Spanish companies dedicated to the import and distribution of IT products. Over 30 years in the industry guarantee our expertise. Located near to Madrid Airport, in a great strategic point for logistics. We enjoy modern facilities, a 17.000m2 warehouse with capacity to 12.000 pallets, and automated processes. DMI Computer is owned by 100% Spanish capital, with more than 120 committed professionals and with great experience in the industry. Our Company offers an excellent customer service to our partners, excellence is our main goal. In addition, we provide our manufacturers with a 360º service: logistics and technical support. We have different market segments, which allow us to reach all kind of partners, offering the best solutions and services proposals: * International Distribution (new) * DMI PRO * DMI Computer Open channel * Retail * E-Tailers * Buying Groups * Large Distribution Accounts Our core business has been IT components, we have Tier 1 and Tier 2 agreements with the main IT manufacturers. We’re successfully developing other product families of consumer electronics: Mobile, Gaming, TVs, SDA... let's work together!
